newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan seeks 270,000 T US/Australian wheat-trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan seeks 270,000 T US/Australian wheat-trade.

text.p: Pakistan will tender in mid-January for 270,000 tonnes U.S. and/or Australian wheat, U.S. exporters said.
Several exporters said the shipment was slated for February and that Pakistan would be looking at both U.S. and Australian wheat.
"The tender will be for the weekend of January 10 (Friday)," a U.S. exporter said. Another exporter said Pakistan was expected to tender on January 12.
The deal would include U.S. grade no 2 or better soft white wheat but U.S. exporters did not identify the type of Australian wheat.
Earlier this week, Pakistan decided to import 600,000 more tonnes of wheat to stablilize domestic prices.
In December, the Pakistani Food and Agriculture Ministry bought 270,000 tonnes of wheat from U.S. and Australian suppliers for shipment by January 31.
